records.source: So, how was your first night in the old cottage?#$e#Your grandpa used to complain about the rickety old bed. But I think, deep down, he actually loved that house.
records.translation: Kaya, kumusta ang una mong gabi sa lumang Kubo?#$e#Madalas ireklamo ng Lolo mo ang luma at marupok na kama. Pero sa kaibuturan niya, sa tingin ko ay talagang mahal niya ang bahay na iyon.

records.source: I've sampled many teas in my life, but none are quite so rare and special as this. Thanks!
records.translation: Marami na akong natikmang tsaa sa buhay, pero walang kasimbihira at natatangi nito. Salamat!

records.source: Ah, you remembered the old mayor's birthday. That's very thoughtful of you. And it's a nice gift!$h
records.translation: Ah, naalala mo ang kaarawan ng matandang mayor. Napakamaalalahanin mo. At maganda ang regalo!$h

records.source: I just got off the phone with the Governor... Apparently this rain is supposed to be completely harmless. Just an unusual phenomenon of nature.#$b#Still, some of the townsfolk are panicking, which is never good...
records.translation: Katatapos ko lang makipag-usap sa Gobernador sa telepono... Lumilitaw na hindi raw mapanganib ang ulang ito. Di-pangkaraniwang pangyayari lamang sa kalikasan.#$b#Gayunman, nagpapanik ang ilang tagabayan, at hindi iyon mabuti...

records.source: Well, that was quite the excitement for our little town! I'm just relieved that everyone is okay.$h#$e#If this ever happens again, I think we'll all be a little more relaxed. It's not the end of the world!
records.translation: Aba, talagang matindi ang kaguluhang iyon para sa munting bayan natin! Nakahinga ako nang maluwag na ayos ang lahat.$h#$e#Kung mangyari ulit ito, sa tingin ko ay mas magiging panatag tayong lahat. Hindi pa katapusan ng mundo!

records.source: I guess we can expect these unusual rains every year. I think everyone is a little calmer knowing that it's just part of nature.
records.translation: Marahil maaasahan na natin taun-taon ang di-pangkaraniwang ulang ito. Sa tingin ko, mas kalmado ang lahat dahil alam nating bahagi lamang ito ng kalikasan.

records.source: Ah, you remembered the old mayor's birthday... what's this?$h#$b#Um... well you know what they say, 'it's the thought that counts'.
records.translation: Ah, naalala mo ang kaarawan ng matandang mayor... Ano ito?$h#$b#Um... Aba, alam mo ang sabi nila, “ang pag-alala ang mahalaga”.

records.source: Hey, I was doing my nightly rounds, and noticed that your first parsnip was ready. Congratulations!
records.translation: Uy, umiikot ako kagabi at napansin kong maaari nang anihin ang una mong parsnip. Binabati kita!

records.source: Those melons have been looking real good over at %farm farm!$h#$b#You know, that was one of your grandpa's favorite crops back in the day.
records.translation: Napakaganda ng hitsura ng mga melon sa Bukid na %farm!$h#$b#Alam mo, isa iyon sa mga paboritong pananim ng Lolo mo noong araw.

records.source: Nothing says 'Fall' quite like a pumpkin, don't you think?
records.translation: Walang higit na nagsasabing “Taglagas” kaysa kalabasa, hindi ba?

records.source: I'm impressed, @. You've really fixed up the place!$h
records.translation: Hanga ako, @. Talagang naayos mo ang lugar!$h

records.source: Congratulations, @. This is a big step forward for you and %spouse. You've really grown some roots in this town!
records.translation: Binabati kita, @. Malaking hakbang ito para sa inyo ni %spouse. Talagang nag-ugat ka na sa bayang ito!

records.source: Congratulations once again, @.
records.translation: Muli kitang binabati, @.

records.source: The divorce paperwork is all squared away. Sorry that things didn't work out...
records.translation: Maayos na ang lahat ng papeles sa diborsiyo. Ikinalulungkot kong hindi nagtagumpay ang pagsasama...

records.source: Another divorce? C'mon, @... you should be a little more careful who you decide to marry in the future...$u
records.translation: Isa na namang diborsiyo? Naku, @... Dapat mas mag-ingat ka nang kaunti sa pipiliin mong pakasalan sa hinaharap...$u

records.source: All the young people seem happy about the new movie theater.#$e#A thriving theater will be good for the local economy. I just hope there's nothing objectionable in those modern pictures!
records.translation: Mukhang masaya ang lahat ng kabataan sa bagong sinehan.#$e#Makabubuti sa lokal na ekonomiya ang isang masiglang sinehan. Sana lamang walang di-kanais-nais sa mga makabagong pelikulang iyon!

records.source: Everyone aboard! We're heading back to the valley!
records.translation: Sakay na ang lahat! Babalik tayo sa lambak!

records.source: Vacation opportunities like this could really expand the local economy!#$e#I'd better not stay in the sun too long, or my moustache will dry out.
records.translation: Talagang mapalalawak ng mga pagkakataong magbakasyon na tulad nito ang lokal na ekonomiya!#$e#Mabuting huwag akong magbilad nang matagal sa araw, kung hindi ay matutuyo ang bigote ko.

records.source: Hehe... look at this place! I don't know how you did it, but this little vacation spot is the talk of the town.$h
records.translation: Hehe... Tingnan mo ang lugar na ito! Hindi ko alam kung paano mo nagawa, pero usap-usapan sa bayan ang munting bakasyunang ito.$h

records.source: Hehe... Gus is really in his element.
records.translation: Hehe... Talagang komportable si Gus sa ginagawa niya.

records.source: @, I heard what you did for Pam and Penny... now *that's* the kind of community support I love to see in Pelican Town!$h
records.translation: @, narinig ko ang ginawa mo para kina Pam at Penny... *iyan* ang uri ng pagtutulungan sa komunidad na gustong-gusto kong makita sa Bayan ng Pelican!$h

records.source: @, did you hear? Someone paid Robin to build Pam and Penny a house! Robin won't tell me who it was, though.#$e#Regardless of who paid, I love seeing this kind of community support in Pelican Town!$h
records.translation: @, narinig mo ba? May nagbayad kay Robin upang ipagtayo sina Pam at Penny ng bahay! Pero ayaw sabihin sa akin ni Robin kung sino iyon.#$e#Sinuman ang nagbayad, gustong-gusto kong makita ang ganitong pagtutulungan sa komunidad ng Bayan ng Pelican!$h

records.source: *sniff*... *sniff*... can you smell that? I've been catching hints of fresh crab all day...$u
records.translation: *singhot*... *singhot*... Naaamoy mo ba iyon? Buong araw akong nakalalanghap ng bahagyang amoy ng sariwang alimango...$u

records.source: *sniff*... *sniff*... Ah, I sense you've been spending some time in the old Community Center. It's good to know someone's taking care of the place.
records.translation: *singhot*... *singhot*... Ah, nararamdaman kong nagpalipas ka ng oras sa lumang Sentro ng Komunidad. Mabuting malaman na may nag-aalaga sa lugar.

records.source: I've never felt such an overwhelming pride in our community. You've done Pelican Town a great service, @.$h
records.translation: Hindi pa ako nakaramdam ng ganitong nakalululang pagmamalaki sa komunidad natin. Napakalaking paglilingkod ang ginawa mo para sa Bayan ng Pelican, @.$h

records.source: Somehow, that old bridge to the quarry is now repaired.#$b#I'm shocked... It must've taken a whole team to fix that thing!#$b#Who could've done that?
records.translation: Sa kung anong paraan, naayos na ang lumang tulay papunta sa tibagan.#$b#Nagulat ako... Tiyak na isang buong pangkat ang kinailangan upang ayusin iyon!#$b#Sino kaya ang gumawa?

records.source: @, did you hear? It seems the old town bus started working again overnight!$h#$b#That old thing has been dormant for decades... This is truly a great mystery.
records.translation: @, narinig mo ba? Mukhang biglang gumana ulit kagabi ang lumang bus ng bayan!$h#$b#Ilang dekada nang hindi gumagana ang lumang bus na iyon... Talagang malaking hiwaga ito.

records.source: So, the old Community Center is gone... I guess times change, and good things come and go... Yet I can't help but feel a sense of loss.$s#$e#I just hope this doesn't mar my record as Mayor.$s
records.translation: Kaya, wala na ang lumang Sentro ng Komunidad... Marahil nagbabago ang panahon, at dumarating at nawawala ang mabubuting bagay... Pero hindi ko maiwasang makaramdam ng panghihinayang.$s#$e#Sana hindi nito dungisan ang tala ko bilang Mayor.$s

records.source: Congrats on winning that grange display competition.#$e#Hehe... Just between you and me, I think Pierre needed a bowl of humble pudding!$h
records.translation: Binabati kita sa pagkapanalo sa paligsahan ng eksibit sa Perya.#$e#Hehe... Sa ating dalawa lang, sa tingin ko ay kailangan ni Pierre ng isang mangkok ng puding ng pagpapakumbaba!$h

records.source: It's a good season to start thinking about gardening, even for us non-farmers.#$e# The valley is known for producing some of the finest spring flowers!$h
records.translation: Magandang panahon upang magsimulang mag-isip tungkol sa paghahardin, kahit para sa aming mga hindi magsasaka.#$e# Kilala ang lambak sa ilan sa pinakamagagandang bulaklak sa tagsibol!$h

records.source: Just place anything you want to sell in the shipping box next to your house.#$e#I'll be interested in seeing what kinds of things you put in there.
records.translation: Ilagay lang sa Kahong Padalhan sa tabi ng bahay ang anumang gusto mong ibenta.#$e#Interesado akong makita kung anong uri ng mga bagay ang ilalagay mo roon.

records.source: Hi, Gus!
records.translation: Kumusta, Gus!

records.source: At the start of each season you'll have to remove the previous season's dead crops. It's easiest with a scythe.
records.translation: Sa simula ng bawat panahon, kailangan mong alisin ang mga patay na pananim mula sa nakaraang panahon. Karit ang pinakamadaling gamitin para rito.

records.source: Have you planted any spring crops yet? The season doesn't last forever, you know.
records.translation: Nagtanim ka na ba ng anumang pananim na pang-tagsibol? Hindi magtatagal ang panahon ng tagsibol, alam mo.

records.source: #$c .3#You're in town early, huh? Finished with your farm chores already?#$e#Good morning! I'm just checking on the garden as usual.$h#$c .5#Hmm... are these aphids?$s#$e#Hmm... I hope these aren't scale bugs...$s
records.translation: #$c .3#Maaga ka sa bayan, ano? Tapos ka na ba sa mga gawain sa bukid?#$e#Magandang umaga! Tinitingnan ko lang ang hardin gaya ng dati.$h#$c .5#Hmm... mga dapulak ba ito?$s#$e#Hmm... Sana hindi mga insektong-kaliskis ang mga ito...$s

records.source: Hmm... tax collection... *mumble* ...spring festivities expenses... *mumble*...$u#$e#Yes?
records.translation: Hmm... pangongolekta ng buwis... *bulong*... mga gastos sa pista ng tagsibol... *bulong*...$u#$e#Ano iyon?

records.source: Ah... There's nothing like a strong cup of tea in the morning.
records.translation: Ah... Walang tatalo sa isang tasang matapang na tsaa sa umaga.

records.source: The saloon can get pretty lively at night. Sometimes we even put a coin in the jukebox *chuckle*$h#$e#I like to visit once a week or so to catch up on things, anyway.
records.translation: Maaaring maging napakasigla ng saloon sa gabi. Minsan ay naghuhulog pa kami ng barya sa jukebox. *tawa*$h#$e#Gusto kong dumalaw nang mga isang beses bawat linggo upang makibalita.

records.source: Good evening! It's nice to see you socializing with the townsfolk.#$b#It's good to stop by once in a while and see what the latest news is.$h
records.translation: Magandang gabi! Masayang makita kang nakikisalamuha sa mga tagabayan.#$b#Mabuting dumaan paminsan-minsan upang malaman ang pinakabagong balita.$h

records.source: Good evening, @! I'm glad to see you relaxing at the saloon. It's good for you to take a break now and then.$h#$b#Your grandfather always worked himself too hard... I'll have an extra beer in his honor tonight.
records.translation: Magandang gabi, @! Natutuwa akong nakikita kang nagpapahinga sa saloon. Mabuti para sa iyo ang magpahinga paminsan-minsan.$h#$b#Palaging nagpapakapagod nang labis ang Lolo mo... Iinom ako ng dagdag na serbesa bilang parangal sa kaniya ngayong gabi.

records.source: I hope things are going well on %farm farm. I'd hate to see it all dried up.
records.translation: Sana maayos ang lahat sa Bukid na %farm. Ayaw kong makita itong matuyo.

records.source: Everyone seems a little happier on the weekends, don't you think?#$e#I'm on the job seven days a week, though.
records.translation: Mukhang mas masaya nang kaunti ang lahat tuwing katapusan ng linggo, hindi ba?#$e#Pero pitong araw bawat linggo akong nagtatrabaho.

records.source: I've been Mayor of Pelican Town for over twenty years!#$e#No one ever runs against me when it's time for an election. I like to think that it means I'm doing my job well.#$e#I like being Mayor.
records.translation: Mahigit dalawampung taon na akong Mayor ng Bayan ng Pelican!#$e#Walang kumakalaban sa akin tuwing halalan. Gusto kong isipin na ibig sabihin niyon ay mahusay kong ginagawa ang trabaho.#$e#Gusto kong maging Mayor.

records.source: Thank you @. I won't forget this.
records.translation: Salamat, @. Hindi ko ito malilimutan.

records.source: *sob* ... I can't believe you would do that...$s#$b#You're terrible.$s
records.translation: *hikbi*... Hindi ako makapaniwalang gagawin mo iyon...$s#$b#Napakasama mo.$s

records.source: Gardening is a hobby of mine, so I'm excited for this warm weather.
records.translation: Libangan ko ang paghahardin, kaya sabik ako sa mainit na panahong ito.

records.source: #$c .3#Ah, my flowers are growing wonderfully!$h#$c .3#Good morning! Can you smell the sweet scent of these dew-lilies?#$e#It's early but the air is already quite warm. Summer is nice for an old guy like me hehe.
records.translation: #$c .3#Ah, napakaganda ng paglago ng mga bulaklak ko!$h#$c .3#Magandang umaga! Naaamoy mo ba ang matamis na halimuyak ng mga liryong-hamog na ito?#$e#Maaga pa, pero mainit-init na ang hangin. Maganda ang tag-init para sa matandang tulad ko, hehe.

records.source: How did I become Mayor in the first place? It's a long story.#$e#We're both too busy for stories right now.
records.translation: Paano nga ba ako naging Mayor noong una? Mahabang kuwento iyon.#$e#Pareho tayong masyadong abala para sa mga kuwento ngayon.

records.source: The moonlight jellies will be here soon. It's one of my favorite things about the valley.
records.translation: Malapit nang dumating ang mga Dikya ng Liwanag ng Buwan. Isa iyon sa mga paborito ko sa lambak.

records.source: The saloon gets pretty lively at night.#$e#I like to visit once a week or so to catch up on things. And to get a taste of Gus' authentic spaghetti.
records.translation: Nagiging napakasigla ng saloon sa gabi.#$e#Gusto kong dumalaw nang mga isang beses bawat linggo upang makibalita at matikman ang tunay na spaghetti ni Gus.

records.source: Hmm... I wonder if it's anyone's birthday today? I'd better check the calendar by Pierre's shop.
records.translation: Hmm... May nagdiriwang kaya ng kaarawan ngayon? Mabuting tingnan ko ang kalendaryo sa tabi ng tindahan ni Pierre.

records.source: Everyone seems a little happier on the weekends, don't you think?#$e#I'm on the job seven days a week, though.
records.translation: Mukhang mas masaya nang kaunti ang lahat tuwing katapusan ng linggo, hindi ba?#$e#Pero pitong araw bawat linggo akong nagtatrabaho.

records.source: Say, are you growing any blueberries on your farm?#$e#I do enjoy a fresh blueberry.%revealtaste:Lewis:258
records.translation: Sabihin mo nga, nagtatanim ka ba ng blueberry sa bukid?#$e#Talagang gusto ko ang sariwang blueberry.%revealtaste:Lewis:258

records.source: Some of the townsfolk are wary of strangers. You'll have to win their trust before they open up to you.#$e#Just be persistent and you'll get through to them.$h
records.translation: Maingat sa mga estranghero ang ilang tagabayan. Kailangan mong makuha ang tiwala nila bago sila magbukas ng loob.#$e#Magpatuloy ka lang at mapalalapit ka rin sa kanila.$h

records.source: It was around this time of year when I first became Mayor, over twenty years ago.#$e#That makes me feel really old.$s
records.translation: Sa ganitong panahon ng taon ako unang naging Mayor mahigit dalawampung taon na ang nakalipas.#$e#Pakiramdam ko ay napakatanda ko na dahil doon.$s

records.source: If you have any suggestions for the town, just drop a note into my suggestion box.#$e#Oh, that's right... I don't have a suggestion box.
records.translation: Kung may mungkahi ka para sa bayan, maghulog lang ng sulat sa kahon ko ng mga mungkahi.#$e#Ah, tama... Wala pala akong kahon ng mga mungkahi.

records.source: Every Wednesday I have buckwheat waffles and coffee for breakfast. It's a little tradition I observe to keep the bachelor life interesting.$h
records.translation: Tuwing Miyerkules ay mga waffle na buckwheat at kape ang almusal ko. Munting tradisyon iyon upang panatilihing kawili-wili ang buhay-binata.$h

records.source: #$c .3#Hmmm... these strange little mushrooms have been popping up in my wood chips. I wonder what kind they are?#$c .3#Good morning! We're slowly entering the cold months, so I'm seeing my garden to a gentle end.#$e#Ah, you're in town early, huh? Finished with your farm chores already?
records.translation: #$c .3#Hmmm... May mga kakaibang munting kabuteng sumusulpot sa mga piraso ng kahoy ko. Anong uri kaya ang mga iyon?#$c .3#Magandang umaga! Unti-unti tayong pumapasok sa malamig na mga buwan, kaya marahan ko nang inihahanda ang hardin sa pagtatapos ng panahon.#$e#Ah, maaga ka sa bayan, ano? Tapos ka na ba sa mga gawain sa bukid?

records.source: The saloon gets pretty lively at night.#$e#I like to visit once a week or so to catch up on things.
records.translation: Nagiging napakasigla ng saloon sa gabi.#$e#Gusto kong dumalaw nang mga isang beses bawat linggo upang makibalita.

records.source: I hope things are going well for you on the farm.
records.translation: Sana maayos ang lahat para sa iyo sa bukid.

records.source: Do you have any bee houses on your farm?#$e#If you place them near flowers you can get different types of honey.
records.translation: May mga Bahay ng Bubuyog ka ba sa bukid?#$e#Kung ilalagay mo ang mga iyon malapit sa mga bulaklak, makakakuha ka ng iba’t ibang uri ng pulot.

records.source: Sometimes you can tell if there's something buried underground. Just keep your eyes open.
records.translation: Minsan ay makikita mo kung may nakabaon sa ilalim ng lupa. Maging mapagmasid ka lang.

records.source: Have you tried Gus' 'secret' spaghetti sauce?$s#$b#...The ingredients may be secret, but the smell isn't.#$b#I'll see you later.
records.translation: Natikman mo na ba ang “lihim” na sarsa ng spaghetti ni Gus?$s#$b#...Maaaring lihim ang mga sangkap, pero hindi ang amoy.#$b#Magkita tayo mamaya.

records.source: Are you doing your best on the farm, @? You'll have to accomplish things in many areas if you want to become a well-rounded citizen.
records.translation: Ginagawa mo ba ang lahat ng makakaya mo sa bukid, @? Kailangan mong magtagumpay sa maraming larangan kung gusto mong maging ganap na mamamayan.

records.source: Well, winter is here! That means the townspeople will be spending most of their days indoors.#$e#At least you'll know where to find them!$h
records.translation: Aba, narito na ang taglamig! Ibig sabihin, gugugulin ng mga tagabayan ang karamihan ng kanilang araw sa loob.#$e#Alam mo man lang kung saan sila matatagpuan!$h

records.source: Another year is almost over!#$e#I hope you had a productive year!
records.translation: Malapit nang matapos ang isa na namang taon!#$e#Sana naging produktibo ang taon mo!

records.source: I've got to start coming up with a plan for improving our town next year!
records.translation: Kailangan ko nang magsimulang bumuo ng plano upang pagandahin ang bayan sa susunod na taon!

records.source: I'll still come by every night to collect your produce, even in the snow.#$e#You still need to make money in the winter!
records.translation: Pupunta pa rin ako gabi-gabi upang kolektahin ang ani mo, kahit umuulan ng niyebe.#$e#Kailangan mo pa ring kumita sa taglamig!

records.source: I hope things are going well for you on the farm.
records.translation: Sana maayos ang lahat para sa iyo sa bukid.

records.source: I've never been married. I have no family. All I live for is to be Mayor.$s#$e#Is it worth it?$s#$e#...*sigh*...$s
records.translation: Hindi pa ako nakapag-asawa. Wala akong pamilya. Ang tanging dahilan ng buhay ko ay ang maging Mayor.$s#$e#Sulit ba iyon?$s#$e#...*buntong-hininga*...$s

records.source: Hi there, @! How're you doing today?$h#$e#If you see Marnie, tell her I say 'hi'.
records.translation: Kumusta, @! Kumusta ka ngayon?$h#$e#Kung makita mo si Marnie, sabihin mong kinukumusta ko siya.
